questions.stem: What is the name of the extra month added to some calendars to keep them in sync with the solar year?
questions.solution: Adhika Maasa is the name of the extra month added to some calendars to align them with the solar year. This adjustment is necessary because the lunar year is shorter than the solar year. Kartika, Chaitra, and Vaisakha are regular months in the traditional calendar and do not serve this purpose.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a reason for the shift in the dates of festivals based on the sidereal calendar?
choices: The Earth's axis wobbles like a top
The Moon's orbit around the Earth is elliptical
The Sun's position in the sky changes daily
questions.solution: The Earth's axis wobbles like a top, causing a slow shift in the orientation of the axis over time, which affects the dates of festivals based on the sidereal calendar. The Moon's elliptical orbit and the Sun's daily movement do not cause long-term shifts in the calendar. The Earth's rotation speed changing would not affect the alignment of the calendar with the stars.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक कारण है जिसके कारण नक्षत्रीय कैलेंडर पर आधारित त्योहारों की तिथियाँ बदल जाती हैं?
choices: पृथ्वी के अक्ष का घूमना एक घूमते हुए टॉप की तरह होता है

hi.solution: पृथ्वी के अक्ष का घूमना एक घूमते हुए टॉप की तरह होता है, जिसके कारण समय के साथ अक्ष के अभिमुखीकरण में धीरे-धीरे परिवर्तन होता है, जो नक्षत्रीय कैलेंडर पर आधारित त्योहारों की तिथियों को प्रभावित करता है। चंद्रमा की अंडाकार कक्षा और सूर्य की दैनिक गति लंबे समय तक कैलेंडर में परिवर्तन नहीं लाती है। पृथ्वी के घूर्णन की गति में परिवर्तन कैलेंडर के तारों के साथ संरेखण को प्रभावित नहीं करेगा।

questions.stem: Which month marks the beginning of the Indian National Calendar?
questions.solution: The Indian National Calendar begins with the month of Chaitra, which starts on 22 March, the day after the spring equinox. Vaisakha, Jyeshtha, and Ashadha are subsequent months in the calendar and do not mark the beginning. The correct option is Chaitra because it is the first month of the year.

hi.stem: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कैलेंडर के शुरू होने का महीना कौन-सा है?

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of launching artificial satellites?
questions.solution: The main purpose of launching artificial satellites is to monitor Earth's weather, as they provide critical data for forecasting and tracking atmospheric conditions. Measuring time is not a primary function of satellites, studying the Moon's phases is not a major objective, and observing tides is not the main purpose of satellite launches.

hi.stem: कृत्रिम उपग्रहों के छोड़े जाने का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?
choices: चंद्रमा के चरणों का अध्ययन करना
पृथ्वी के मौसम की निगरानी करना
hi.solution: कृत्रिम उपग्रहों के छोड़े जाने का मुख्य उद्देश्य पृथ्वी के मौसम की निगरानी करना है, क्योंकि वे वातावरणीय स्थितियों के अनुमान और ट्रैकिंग के लिए महत्वपूर्ण डेटा प्रदान करते हैं। समय का मापन उपग्रहों का प्राथमिक कार्य नहीं है, चंद्रमा के चरणों का अध्ययन एक प्रमुख उद्देश्य नहीं है, और ज्वार-भाटा का अवलोकन उपग्रह छोड़े जाने का मुख्य उद्देश्य नहीं है।
hi.critique: Translation is accurate, maintains original meaning, and uses standard Hindi scientific terminology.

mr.stem: कृत्रिम उपग्रह लॉन्च करण्याचा मुख्य उद्देश काय आहे?
mr.solution: कृत्रिम उपग्रह लॉन्च करण्याचा मुख्य उद्देश पृथ्वीच्या हवामानाचा निरीक्षण करणे आहे, कारण ते वातावरणीय स्थितींचे अंदाज आणि ट्रॅकिंगसाठी महत्त्वपूर्ण माहिती प्रदान करतात. वेळ मोजणे हे उपग्रहांचे प्राथमिक कार्य नाही, चंद्राच्या फेरी अभ्यास करणे हे मुख्य उद्देश नाही, आणि ज्वारीचा अभ्यास करणे हा उपग्रह लॉन्चचा मुख्य उद्देश नाही.

questions.stem: How long does it take for the Moon to complete one full cycle of phases?
questions.solution: The Moon takes about a month to complete one full cycle of phases because its orbit around Earth takes that long. A week is the time for half the cycle, not the full cycle. A year and a day are unrelated to the Moon's phase cycle.

hi.stem: चंद्रमा के चरणों के एक पूर्ण चक्र को पूरा करने में कितना समय लगता है?
hi.solution: चंद्रमा के पृथ्वी के चारों ओर कक्षा में एक माह लगता है, इसलिए चरणों के एक पूर्ण चक्र को पूरा करने में लगभग एक माह लगता है। एक सप्ताह आधे चक्र के समय के बराबर होता है, न कि पूरे चक्र के लिए। एक वर्ष और एक दिन चंद्रमा के चरण चक्र से संबंधित नहीं हैं।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate technical terms as found in Hindi-medium textbooks.

mr.stem: चंद्राच्या फेरींच्या एकूण चक्राचे पूर्ण करण्यास किती वेळ लागतो?
mr.solution: चंद्राला पृथ्वीच्या फेरींचे एकूण चक्र पूर्ण करण्यास एक महिना लागतो कारण त्याच्या फेरींचे एकूण चक्र पूर्ण करण्यास त्याच्या फेरींचे वेळ लागतो. आठवडा हा अर्धा चक्र असतो, पूर्ण चक्र नाही. वर्ष आणि दिवस चंद्राच्या फेरींच्या चक्राशी संबंधित नाहीत.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the original meaning, and uses appropriate Marathi terminology for astronomical concepts.

questions.stem: If a student observes the Moon during a Full Moon, which of the following statements is correct?
choices: The entire illuminated portion of the Moon faces the Earth
Only a part of the illuminated portion of the Moon is visible
The Moon does not reflect any sunlight
The Earth is blocking the sunlight from reaching the Moon
questions.solution: The correct answer is that the entire illuminated portion of the Moon faces the Earth. During a Full Moon, the Moon is on the opposite side of the Earth from the Sun, so the entire illuminated side is visible from Earth. The other options are incorrect because only a part of the illuminated portion is not visible during a Full Moon, the Moon does reflect sunlight, and the Earth is not blocking the sunlight during a Full Moon, as the Moon is on the opposite side of the Earth from the Sun.

questions.stem: Meera noticed the Moon during the day. What could explain this?
choices: The Moon is always visible during the day
The Moon reflects sunlight and can be seen during the day
The Moon is in a different phase
The Moon is closer to Earth
questions.solution: The Moon reflects sunlight, which allows it to be visible during the day when the Sun is also in the sky. The idea that the Moon is always visible during the day is incorrect because its visibility depends on its position relative to the Earth and Sun. The Moon's phase and distance from Earth do not determine its visibility during the day, as these factors affect its appearance and timing, not whether it can be seen.

questions.stem: If a lunar calendar is used, how might the seasons be affected over time?
choices: They will shift by about 50 minutes each year
They will shift slightly each year
They will change completely every year

questions.stem: Why is the full Moon day called Purnima?
choices: Because the Moon is completely visible
Because the Moon is closest to Earth
Because the Moon is in a new phase
Because the Moon is in a waning phase
questions.solution: The correct option is because the Moon is completely visible, as this occurs when the Earth is between the Sun and the Moon, making the entire face of the Moon illuminated. The Moon being closest to Earth relates to a supermoon, not Purnima. A new phase means the Moon is not visible, which contradicts the idea of a full Moon. A waning phase means the Moon is decreasing in visibility, which is the opposite of a full Moon.

questions.stem: Why do festivals based on luni-solar calendars have a smaller date shift in the Gregorian calendar compared to purely lunar calendars?
